reference: Michael Scott, to Andy, in The Chump (S6E23). Andy: 'You're Ali Larter, I'm Beyonce.' Michael: 'I am Beyonce always.' (Reference to the film Obsessed.)

evidence.line: Andy: In any cheating movie, the person getting cheated on is the hero. You're Ali Larter, I'm Beyonce. Michael: I am Beyonce always. Andy: Not this time. Michael: Yes, I am.

caveats: Transcript wording has no comma ('I am Beyonce always'). The film name (Obsessed) is not in the transcript.
question: Who says "I am Beyoncé, always"?
